n2d08b984804.s: The Governing Council of NITI Aayog primarily performs which function?
o: Coordinating policy among the Centre and the States
Allocating plan funds to Union Ministries
Approving the annual plan outlays of States
n2d08b984804.x: The Governing Council coordinates policy between the Centre and the States; NITI Aayog has no financial powers to redistribute plan grants.

ndf7a02a0f9b.s: The Third Five Year Plan achieved a growth rate of only ____ per cent against a target of 5.6 per cent.
ndf7a02a0f9b.x: The Third Plan grew only 2.2% against its 5.6% target, hit by the 1962 and 1965 wars and the 1965-66 droughts.

n51b4c186fa1.s: Padma Desai co-authored 'India: Planning for Industrialization' (1970) with:
n51b4c186fa1.x: Padma Desai, a critic of India's planned economy and the first Asian woman to earn a Harvard Economics PhD, co-authored the 1970 work with Jagdish Bhagwati.

ne4357332fb4.s: The Fourth Five Year Plan targeted annual agricultural growth of:
ne4357332fb4.x: The Fourth Plan targeted 5% annual agricultural growth; about 7% a year was its export growth target.

n7d022a58d77.s: Which of the following correctly describes the outcome of land reforms in India?
o: Poorly implemented; income inequality reduced substantially
Poorly implemented; unequal land ownership persisted
Well implemented; unequal land ownership ended
Well implemented; income inequality reduced substantially
n7d022a58d77.x: Land reforms were poorly implemented and unequal land ownership persisted; income inequality was not reduced but widened.

n6ea4b9e396a.s: In which year was the National Development Council established?
n6ea4b9e396a.x: The NDC was established in 1952, two years after the Planning Commission (1950).

ne6f08788a34.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the composition of NITI Aayog?
o: The Prime Minister is its Chairperson.
The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister.
The resolution fixes the number of full-time members at five.
Up to two part-time members may come from universities and research institutions.
ne6f08788a34.x: The resolution does not prescribe a fixed number of full-time members; the other three statements are correct.

n3125e048053.s: Which of the following is NOT an objective of NITI Aayog in its Cabinet resolution?
o: Allocating plan funds and grants to the States
Ensuring national security interests are considered in economic policy
n3125e048053.x: NITI Aayog has no fund-allocation power; allocating plan funds was the Planning Commission's role.

nb913c0b7ad8.s: Which of the following is NOT a guiding priority of NITI Aayog?
nb913c0b7ad8.x: An exclusive preference for large enterprises is contrary to NITI Aayog's approach, which includes Antyodaya, small enterprises and inclusive development.

n86f8cbc416a.s: The SETU (State Economic and Transformation Units) Steering Committee is chaired by the ____ of NITI Aayog.
n86f8cbc416a.x: The SETU Steering Committee is chaired by the CEO of NITI Aayog, not the Vice-Chairperson.

n9ceae71ccb0.s: The Regional Councils of NITI Aayog are convened by the:
n9ceae71ccb0.x: Regional Councils, dealing with issues affecting more than one State, are convened by the Prime Minister.

n70f56ec26b2.s: The DMEO was formed in 2015 by merging the Programme Evaluation Organisation (PEO) with the:
n70f56ec26b2.x: DMEO was formed by merging the PEO and the IEO; NILERD (formerly IAMR) is a separate autonomous institute.

n0674a29e114.s: The Planning Commission could have up to how many full-time members?
n0674a29e114.x: The Planning Commission had up to eight full-time members and no part-time members.

n45aab94e67b.s: The Zonal Councils, statutory bodies under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956, are chaired by the:
n45aab94e67b.x: Zonal Councils are chaired by the Union Home Minister; a NITI Aayog representative attends as an adviser.

nfe04112eae1.s: NITI in NITI Aayog stands for:
o: National Institution for Transformation of India
nfe04112eae1.x: NITI stands for National Institution for Transforming India; it is a non-constitutional, non-statutory body.

nca5b0b891a4.s: The 11th meeting of the Governing Council of NITI Aayog was held on:
nca5b0b891a4.x: The Governing Council usually meets once a year; its 11th meeting was held on 11 June 2026.

n58878c180f6.x: NITI Aayog is a non-constitutional advisory body created by an executive Cabinet resolution.

nindian-economy-24-3.s: NITI Aayog's core approach combines cooperative federalism with:
nindian-economy-24-3.x: NITI Aayog combines cooperative federalism with a bottom-up approach, giving States a bigger say in policy.

n06249dd8030.s: Which NITI Aayog office-holder has a fixed tenure and the rank of Secretary to the Government of India?
n06249dd8030.x: The CEO, appointed by the Prime Minister, has a fixed tenure and the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.

nfd0438606af.s: Which body allocated plan funds and grants to the States?
nfd0438606af.x: The Planning Commission allocated plan funds and grants; NITI Aayog has no fund-allocation power and is advisory.

n7cea3d2507f.s: Which of the following is one of the four principal areas of NITI Aayog's mandate?
n7cea3d2507f.x: NITI Aayog's mandate covers knowledge and innovation, NITI for States, driving transformational change, and monitoring and evaluation.

n02f1362c273.s: Which State ranked first among the major States in the Fiscal Health Index 2026?
n02f1362c273.x: Odisha ranked first among major States for the second consecutive year; Punjab was last.

n63de712e6dd.s: Andhra Pradesh's composite score in the SDG India Index 2023-24 was:
n63de712e6dd.x: AP's score rose from 72 (2020-21) to 74 (2023-24), placing it in the Front Runner band, though its rank fell from fourth to ninth.

nd257915fe46.s: In the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh ranked first in:
nd257915fe46.x: AP ranked first in SDG 7 and second in SDG 14, and 9th overall.

n9fa5028dcf7.s: In the SDG India Index 2023-24, which SDG was assessed only qualitatively?
n9fa5028dcf7.x: Scores were given for 16 SDGs; SDG 17 was assessed only qualitatively.

n89ce5f1dd5a.s: In the SDG India Index, a State scoring between 65 and 99 is classified as:
n89ce5f1dd5a.x: Achiever is 100, Front Runner 65-99, Performer 50-64 and Aspirant below 50.

n17e7e52e883.s: India's multidimensional poverty in 2022-23 was estimated at:
n17e7e52e883.x: Multidimensional poverty fell from 55.3% (2005-06) to 14.96% (2019-21) and was estimated at 11.28% in 2022-23.

nbb00e41f912.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about economic growth and economic development?
o: Economic development has a narrower scope than economic growth.
Economic development has qualitative and quantitative dimensions.
nbb00e41f912.x: Development has a broader, not narrower, scope than growth.

n8f86d40b231.s: In the Human Development Index, standard of living is measured through:
o: GDP per capita at current prices
Net national income at factor cost
n8f86d40b231.x: The HDI measures standard of living through GNI per capita at PPP, alongside life expectancy and schooling.

n5711082bb0f.shape: NOT (one-liner not honestly buildable: only one false fact)
n5711082bb0f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about indicators of economic development?
o: Workers moving out of agriculture may raise labour productivity.
Rising capital formation is a sign of development.
Human resource development is unrelated to economic development.
Social overhead capital contributes to development.
n5711082bb0f.x: Human resource development is an important sign and component of economic development.

n260eb76dcc5.s: Economic growth is ____ for economic development.
n260eb76dcc5.x: Development cannot occur without some growth, but growth alone may not produce development.

n42655dc1d02.s: The capability approach to development is associated with:
n42655dc1d02.x: The capability approach is Amartya Sen's; Pigou is linked with the welfare approach and Paul Streeten (with the ILO) with basic needs.

nf2ed5fb95b3.s: Which of the following is classified as an economic determinant of growth?
nf2ed5fb95b3.x: Natural resources and technical progress are economic factors; institutions, rule of law, population quality and social structure are non-economic.

n3bc7a1e8a6f.s: The 'critical minimum effort' thesis is associated with:
n3bc7a1e8a6f.x: Critical minimum effort is Leibenstein's; Nurkse gave balanced growth, Hirschman unbalanced growth and Rostow the stages of growth.

n5b3bd03a94a.s: Which of the following is NOT a component of the Physical Quality of Life Index?
n5b3bd03a94a.x: PQLI uses literacy, infant mortality and life expectancy at age one; GNI per capita at PPP is an HDI component.

n68a0b53ffc0.s: Capital formation may fail to increase output when:
o: capital remains idle or is badly used
complementary inputs such as skills and infrastructure are absent
n68a0b53ffc0.x: Idle or misused capital, missing complementary inputs and inadequate demand can each stop capital formation from raising output.

nindian-economy-52-7.x: WPI tracks wholesale prices; CPI tracks retail prices and IIP industrial output.

nindian-economy-67-11.s: The Physical Quality of Life Index (PQLI) is associated with:
nindian-economy-67-11.x: Morris D. Morris is linked with the PQLI; Mahbub-ul-Haq with the HDI, Kuznets with per capita income and Gini with the Gini coefficient.

n2d3211b6a78.s: The Measure of Economic Welfare (MEW) is associated with:
n2d3211b6a78.x: MEW is associated with Nordhaus and Tobin; Net Economic Welfare is associated with Paul Samuelson.

nindian-economy-52-4.s: Which index focuses on basic necessities such as water, sanitation and housing?
nindian-economy-52-4.x: The BNI covers basic necessities like water, sanitation and housing; PQLI uses literacy, IMR and life expectancy.

nindian-economy-27-3.s: Economic development may not be higher despite rising real GNP if ____ increase.
nindian-economy-27-3.x: Higher real GNP need not mean development, because poverty and unemployment can still rise.

n3b611eaa69c.s: The Brundtland definition of sustainable development balances present needs with:
o: a ban on present use of natural resources
the ability of future generations to meet their own needs
n3b611eaa69c.x: Sustainable development meets present needs while preserving future generations' ability to meet theirs; it does not prohibit resource use.

ndd156ebd962.s: 'Development as Freedom', which presents development as the expansion of substantive freedoms, is associated with:
ndd156ebd962.x: Amartya Sen's capability approach, associated with Development as Freedom, treats literacy and health as constituents of development.

na8865e8d120.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Bhagwati-Sen debate?
o: Bhagwati, with Arvind Panagariya, prioritised rapid, market-led growth.
Bhagwati held that growth creates jobs and revenue to finance social spending.
Sen, with Jean Dreze, prioritised public investment in education, health and nutrition.
Sen argued that growth alone removes deprivation.
na8865e8d120.x: Sen argued that growth alone does not remove deprivation.

nindian-economy-70-12.s: In inclusive development, education mainly contributes by:
o: improving capabilities through knowledge and skills
nindian-economy-70-12.x: Education builds capabilities through knowledge and skills; agricultural revival helps rural people and infrastructure widens access.

n08f3d03896a.s: As per the World Bank, India's extreme poverty at the $3-a-day line fell from 27.1% in 2011-12 to ____ in 2022-23.
n08f3d03896a.x: Extreme poverty at $3 a day fell from 27.1% to 5.3%; 23.9% is the 2022-23 figure at the $4.20 line.

nindian-economy-70-13.s: In inclusive growth, MSMEs are chiefly credited with promoting:
nindian-economy-70-13.x: MSMEs create jobs and entrepreneurs; SHGs bring financial participation and credit enables productive activity.

nd449e554ac6.s: Article 31C, protecting laws giving effect to Articles 39(b) and 39(c), was inserted by the:
nd449e554ac6.x: Article 31C was inserted by the 25th Amendment, 1971.

n6e5d3aaecb4.s: Besides the pace of growth, inclusive growth also examines:
o: only the rate of industrial output
the pattern of growth and who receives its benefits
only the rate of GDP growth
n6e5d3aaecb4.x: Inclusive growth considers the pattern of growth and distribution of benefits, including gender and regional balance.

nc9a34088663.s: The three pillars of India's inclusive growth model are:
o: Antyodaya, Empowerment and Poverty and Unemployment
nc9a34088663.x: The three pillars are Market Economics, Empowerment and Pragmatism.

n0949dc05acc.s: DAY-NRLM covers 10.05 crore women in about how many SHGs?
n0949dc05acc.x: DAY-NRLM covers 10.05 crore women in 90.09 lakh SHGs.

ne819eba81c3.s: The Aspirational Districts Programme, with 49 KPIs across five themes, began in:
ne819eba81c3.x: Aspirational Districts began in January 2018; Aspirational Blocks began in January 2023 covering 500 blocks.

n6f1b3141f6c.s: VB-G RAM G, which replaced MGNREGA, guarantees how many days of rural wage employment?
n6f1b3141f6c.x: VB-G RAM G raised the employment guarantee from 100 days to 125 days.

naae36847adb.s: While the World Bank shows poverty in India falling, the World Inequality Database shows income inequality:
naae36847adb.x: The World Bank indicates falling poverty, whereas the World Inequality Database indicates rising income inequality.

n3035285dee8.s: MSMEs account for about what share of India's exports?
n3035285dee8.x: MSMEs contribute 48.58% of exports, 31.1% of GDP and 35.4% of manufacturing output.

n8304f553413.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Inequality-adjusted HDI (IHDI)?
o: It discounts the HDI for inequality.
IHDI exceeds HDI whenever inequality exists.
The HDI-IHDI gap represents the loss due to inequality.
n8304f553413.x: IHDI is lower, not higher, than HDI whenever inequality exists.

nc0db9ab0033.s: In the HDI, the minimum and maximum goalposts for life expectancy are:
nc0db9ab0033.x: Life expectancy goalposts are 20-85 years; 0-18 is for expected schooling and 0-15 for mean schooling.

nindian-economy-69-16.s: Which of the following is primarily an economic measure?
nindian-economy-69-16.x: GDP is mainly an economic measure; the HDI measures human development and the MPI multidimensional poverty.

nbb431327ea9.s: Who extended the capability approach by presenting a list of central human capabilities?
nbb431327ea9.x: Martha Nussbaum extended Sen's capability approach with a list of central human capabilities.

nindian-economy-69-15.s: The first Human Development Report was published by the:
nindian-economy-69-15.x: The UNDP published the first Human Development Report; OPHI works with the UNDP on the MPI.

nb69a09e3357.s: Since 2010, the HDI is calculated as the ____ of its three dimension indices.
nb69a09e3357.x: The geometric mean, introduced in 2010, prevents a strong dimension from fully offsetting a weak one.

ne39da2179b9.s: In HDR 2025, which of the five original BRICS countries ranked lowest?
ne39da2179b9.x: Brazil, Russia, China and South Africa all ranked above India in HDR 2025.

nb9bffb7a514.s: Which Five Year Plan carried the theme 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth'?
nb9bffb7a514.x: The Eleventh Plan (2007-12), the first to make inclusive growth its objective, carried this theme.

nindian-economy-69-20.x: The MPI measures multidimensional poverty, while the HDI measures human development.

nindian-economy-69-13.s: In which year was the first Human Development Report published?
nindian-economy-69-13.x: The first Human Development Report came out in 1990, based on Mahbub-ul-Haq's human development approach.

nindian-economy-69-12.s: The Multidimensional Poverty Index is produced by:
nindian-economy-69-12.x: The MPI is produced by OPHI and UNDP together, not UNDP alone.

n7aec3065d9f.s: Under the updated Rangarajan estimates (HCES 2022-23), rural poverty was highest in Chhattisgarh at:
n7aec3065d9f.x: Rural poverty was highest in Chhattisgarh (25.1%) and lowest in Himachal Pradesh (0.4%); urban poverty was lowest in Tamil Nadu (1.9%).

n2cfd680a698.s: Andhra Pradesh's multidimensional poverty headcount ratio reported for 2024-25 was:
n2cfd680a698.x: AP's headcount ratio was 6.06% (MPI 0.025), under half the national ratio of 14.96%.

n012cd95a29a.s: Self-Help Groups mainly contribute to inclusive growth through:
n012cd95a29a.x: SHGs support women's credit and livelihoods.

n31e822adc44.s: The lower threshold of the 'medium' HDI category is:
n31e822adc44.x: Very high is 0.800+, high 0.700-0.799, medium 0.550-0.699 and low below 0.550.

n4c90f289dd2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NITI Aayog's January 2024 discussion paper on multidimensional poverty?
o: The headcount ratio fell from 29.17% to 11.28%.
About 24.82 crore people escaped multidimensional poverty.
It covered the nine years from 2013-14 to 2022-23.
n4c90f289dd2.x: The paper covered 2013-14 to 2022-23; 2015-16 to 2019-21 is the period of the Progress Review 2023.

n8a83f66e72e.s:
Assertion (A): The World Bank's 2022 poverty estimate at $4.20 a day (23.9%) differs from the MPI estimate for 2022-23 (11.28%).
Reason (R): The two estimates use different poverty lines and count poverty differently.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8a83f66e72e.x: The estimates differ (23.9% vs 11.28%) precisely because they use different poverty lines and methods, so R explains A.

ndf9f898d5ce.s: The Gender Inequality Index (GII) was introduced in the Human Development Report of:
ndf9f898d5ce.x: The GII came in HDR 2010 to address shortcomings of the GDI; a higher GII means more inequality.

n63ea4e795f3.s: India's National MPI uses how many indicators?
n63ea4e795f3.x: The National MPI uses 12 indicators against the Global MPI's 10, with the same three dimensions and the Alkire-Foster method.

n27a1db3411e.s: How many indicators does the standard of living dimension of India's National MPI have?
n27a1db3411e.x: Health has three indicators, education two and standard of living seven.

n17a9155d479.s: In the MPI ranking cited, Andhra Pradesh was ranked:
n17a9155d479.x: AP ranked ninth by MPI; among cited States Kerala had the lowest value (0.002) and Bihar the highest (0.16).

nindian-economy-63-9.s:
Assertion (A): The Global Wage Report is the ILO's study of wage trends worldwide.
Reason (R): The ILO's World Social Security Report was later renamed the World Social Protection Report.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nindian-economy-63-9.x: Both are true ILO facts, but the renaming of one report does not explain the content of the Global Wage Report.

n3f08ea3d363.s: How many input pillars does the Global Innovation Index have?
n3f08ea3d363.x: The GII has five input pillars and two output pillars (knowledge and technology outputs, and creative outputs).

nee6ff96dc11.s: In the Environmental Performance Index 2026, India's overall rank out of 177 countries was:
nee6ff96dc11.x: India ranked 176th of 177 overall, 175th in Air Quality and 130th in Climate Mitigation.

nindian-economy-63-19.s: The State of World Population Report is published by:
nindian-economy-63-19.x: UNFPA publishes the State of World Population; the IMF publishes the WEO and the ILO the World Social Protection Report.

nda83d4a3325.s: The Global Hunger Index is based on undernourishment, child stunting, child mortality and:
nda83d4a3325.x: The four GHI indicators are undernourishment, child stunting, child wasting and child mortality.

nindian-economy-63-5.s: The Global Gender Gap Report is published by the:
nindian-economy-63-5.x: The WEF publishes the Global Gender Gap Report; the World Bank publishes the World Development Report.

nindian-economy-63-16.s: Which of the following is NOT published by the UNDP?
nindian-economy-63-16.x: The Global Gender Gap Report is the WEF's; the other three are UNDP measures.

n6dbfbb6b50d.s: One of India's objections to the EPI methodology was its preference for ____ emissions over per-capita emissions.
n6dbfbb6b50d.x: India objected to the preference for absolute over per-capita emissions, the neglect of CBDR-RC and the use of contested indicators.

ne8410619fc9.s: Which of the following is one of the six variables used in the World Happiness Report?
ne8410619fc9.x: The six variables are GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity and perceptions of corruption.

ne54d59b2737.s: Which of the following pairs (resource – associated condition) is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Groundwater – Deep bore tubewells for irrigation
Sustainable forest retaining biodiversity – Resource depletion
ne54d59b2737.x: A forest managed sustainably for timber while retaining biodiversity is not an instance of resource depletion.

nee8307ce2f6.s:
Assertion (A): The environment performs the function of supplying resources.
Reason (R): It provides both renewable and non-renewable resources.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nee8307ce2f6.x: The resource-supply function means the environment provides renewable and non-renewable resources, so R explains A.

ndae06e6d7ac.s: Green Revolution HYV crops contributed to the depletion of the water table mainly because of their:
ndae06e6d7ac.x: The irrigation needs of HYV crops depleted the water table, while monoculture and chemicals hurt soil fertility and biodiversity.

n89121fde158.s: Which State restored the largest area of land in India during 2011-2020?
n89121fde158.x: Telangana was first (4.18 Mha) and Andhra Pradesh was among the top five of the 21.76 Mha restored.

n15e45c76ff1.s: More than ____ of the world's rivers have been dammed or diverted.
n15e45c76ff1.x: Over 60% of rivers are dammed or diverted; about 40% of land is degraded and about one-third transformed.

n7e5487032af.s: Environmental Impact Assessment was first used in India in 1978 for:
n7e5487032af.x: EIA began in 1978 with river valley projects; the EIA Notification came in 1994 and was revised in 2006.

n30b621f6f6b.s:
Assertion (A): In the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026, India ranked behind Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal and Sri Lanka.
Reason (R): SDG 2 was identified as India's main area of concern.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n30b621f6f6b.x: Both are true (India ranked 94th and lagged on 13 SDGs), but one area of concern does not by itself explain its overall position behind these neighbours.

nf5da53238ce.s: India presented its first Voluntary National Review on the SDGs to the UN in:
nf5da53238ce.x: India's first VNR was in 2017 and covered 7 SDGs; NITI Aayog prepared the VNR 2025.

nc9370ec1b50.s: India's rank in the Sustainable Development Report 2026 was:
nc9370ec1b50.x: India ranked 94th in 2026, 18 places better than in 2015; it first entered the top 100 in 2025.

nf27e9311aad.s: In the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2025, India entered the top 100 for the first time with a rank of:
nf27e9311aad.x: India ranked 99th out of 167 with a score of about 67 in 2025.

n107614256a9.s: Which of the following is one of the three pillars of sustainability?
n107614256a9.x: The three pillars are economic growth, social inclusion or equity, and environmental protection.

n0df9adf6458.s:
Assertion (A): The Vellore Citizens Welfare Forum case, on tannery pollution of the Palar River, applied the precautionary principle.
Reason (R): The same case applied the Polluter Pays Principle.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0df9adf6458.x: The case applied both principles, but applying one does not explain applying the other.

nff6ce047d6d.s: The logo of the Eco-Mark scheme (1991) is:
nff6ce047d6d.x: The Eco-Mark logo is an earthen pot; products are certified by the BIS, not the CPCB.

n2f3986e3fbb.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board classification, 'White' category industries are:
n2f3986e3fbb.x: White-category industries are practically non-polluting; Green-category industries have low pollution potential.

n8f162f2bdf7.s: The National Action Plan on Climate Change, with eight national missions, was released in:
n8f162f2bdf7.x: NAPCC came in 2008 with eight missions; 2006 is the National Environment Policy year.

n6b998eade8d.s: Which of the following is NOT a mission under the NAPCC?
n6b998eade8d.x: The eight NAPCC missions include Solar, Sustainable Agriculture and Green India; Coastal Security is not one of them.

nba1fd2d74de.s: Under the Polluter Pays Principle, the polluter bears:
o: the costs of remediation and compensation for damage
only private compensation claimed by victims
no cost, as liability shifts to the State
nba1fd2d74de.x: The principle covers both remediation of environmental damage and compensation for those affected.

n6cf9e842a3e.s: The Taj Trapezium case is associated with:
o: chemical units in Rajasthan paying for clean-up
the State holding natural resources in trust
the right to pollution-free water and air under Article 21
n6cf9e842a3e.x: The Taj Trapezium case mandated CNG; the Rajasthan chemical units clean-up was the Bichhri case.

n3c944c65493.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Gross Value Added (GVA)?
o: GVA at basic prices has been the headline sectoral measure since the 2011-12 series.
GVA at basic prices is not used in the 2022-23 series.
n3c944c65493.x: GVA at basic prices continues to be used in the 2022-23 series.

na8e41beb8db.s: GDP at factor cost equals GDP at market prices:
na8e41beb8db.x: Indirect taxes and subsidies, not direct taxes, bridge GDP at market prices and at factor cost.

n8718eb52fc2.s: Which of the following is ADDED to national income in arriving at personal income?
n8718eb52fc2.x: Transfer payments are added; undistributed profits, social security contributions and corporate tax are deducted.

n1be3a9a33ea.s: Andhra Pradesh's per capita income in 2024-25 (FAE) was:
n1be3a9a33ea.x: AP's per capita income was Rs. 2,68,653 against India's Rs. 2,00,162 in 2024-25 FAE.

ncf225a575fb.s: National income is the standard term for:
ncf225a575fb.x: NNP at factor cost is national income; NDP = GDP - depreciation and NNP = GNP - depreciation.

n71f5df02633.s: National wealth, measured at a point of time, is a ____ concept.
n71f5df02633.x: National wealth is a stock measured at a point of time; national income is a flow measured over a period.

nindian-economy-5-5.x: Real GDP uses constant base-year prices, nominal GDP current prices; real growth shows true output growth.

nindian-economy-26-5.s: In Real GVA, a base year is used to:
o: remove the effect of price changes
nindian-economy-26-5.x: Real GVA uses constant base-year prices to strip out price changes; nominal GVA uses current prices.

nindian-economy-27-5.x: GNP = NNP + depreciation; national income is NNP at factor cost.

nbdf110f7ed8.s: India's nodal agency for purchasing power parity estimation under the International Comparison Program is the:
nbdf110f7ed8.x: The World Bank is the global implementing agency and the NSO is India's nodal agency.

n3d207955e2d.s: India's GNP is usually lower than its GDP because net factor income from abroad is:
n3d207955e2d.x: India's NFIA is usually negative, making GNP lower than GDP.

n257453cd902.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about State income?
o: 'Income originating' is the value produced within the State's boundaries.
'Income originating' includes income earned by the State's residents abroad.
'Income accruing' adds residents' income earned in other States or abroad.
n257453cd902.x: Residents' income from outside the State is part of income accruing, not income originating.

nce47b36257a.shape: NOT (match not buildable from given facts)
nce47b36257a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the IMF review (Dec 2025) of India's national accounts?
o: It flagged the absence of seasonally adjusted quarterly data.
It read production- and expenditure-side GDP gaps as showing complete capture of informal activity.
It flagged delays in GFCF data by institutional sector.
It saw the persistent GDP gaps as pointing to partial capture of informal activity.
nce47b36257a.x: The persistent gaps point to only partial, not complete, capture of informal activity.

n84bb27a288d.s: Under the income method, national income sums compensation of employees, operating surplus and:
n84bb27a288d.x: The income method sums compensation of employees, operating surplus (rent, interest, profit) and mixed income.

n5e78c9a0d38.s: Whose definition of national income is based on consumption, i.e. services received by ultimate consumers?
n5e78c9a0d38.x: Fisher's definition is consumption-based; Kuznets added net additions to capital stock and Pigou included income from abroad.

n5dc72f35039.s: Which of the following is excluded from national income?
o: Farm output consumed by the producing household
n5dc72f35039.x: Housewives' unpaid services are excluded; imputed rent and self-consumed farm output are included.

nd844a31ff34.s: Which of the following is included in national income?
nd844a31ff34.x: Changes in inventories are included; tax revenue, interest on public debt and housewives' unpaid services are excluded.

nf58fc96b742.s: In the circular flow of income, which of the following is an injection?
nf58fc96b742.x: Injections are investment, government spending and exports; saving, taxes and imports are leakages.

nc21f1f7ecdb.s: In national income accounting, change in inventories equals:
nc21f1f7ecdb.x: Change in inventories is production minus sales, and unsold production counts as output.

n2473f4ec66c.s: In India, the income method of estimating national income is applied mainly to:
n2473f4ec66c.x: India uses the production method for agriculture, mining and manufacturing, and the income method for services.

n35424c68788.s: The new national accounts series improves real GVA measurement through:
n35424c68788.x: The new series uses double deflation and volume extrapolation to estimate real GVA.

n6a4d5aa8974.s: The value added (product) method measures national income by summing:
o: the value added by every producing unit
n6a4d5aa8974.x: The product method sums the value added by each producing unit, avoiding double counting.

na7053ab1969.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the National Statistical Office (NSO)?
o: Conduct of surveys such as PLFS, ASUSE and HCES
na7053ab1969.x: Monetary policy is not an NSO function; national accounts, IIP, CPI and surveys are.

n2170ff962fc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the national accounts series with base year 2022-23?
o: It was released by the NSO, MoSPI on 27 February 2026.
It uses double deflation for manufacturing and agriculture.
It integrates Supply and Use Tables.
It raised the size of nominal GDP for 2022-23 over the old series.
n2170ff962fc.x: The new series cut GDP by 3-4%: nominal 2022-23 GDP fell from about Rs 269 to Rs 261 lakh crore.

n1a8790c474d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the revised PLFS and ASUSE arrangements?
o: PLFS 2025 provides only annual all-India estimates.
District-level PLFS and ASUSE estimates are expected by 2026.
n1a8790c474d.x: PLFS 2025 provides monthly, not only annual, all-India estimates.

n6e2c3d943d1.s:
Assertion (A): The CPI now has base year 2024.
Reason (R): The old CPI base was the calendar year 2012.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n6e2c3d943d1.x: Both are true (IIP, not CPI, was rebased to 2022-23), but the old base year does not explain the choice of the new one.

nbafbe36575c.s: The Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) is conducted by the:
nbafbe36575c.x: The Kolkata wing conducts the ASI; ESD compiles IIP and the National Accounts Division handles GDP.

n9d824ae44d5.x: ASUSE covers unincorporated non-agricultural enterprises; ASI covers registered factories, HCES consumption and TUS time use.

nd77b87a9554.s: The National Income Committee constituted in August 1949 was chaired by:
nd77b87a9554.x: P.C. Mahalanobis chaired it, with Gadgil and Rao as members; its first report came in 1951.

n57dfcbbd28d.s: The National Statistical Commission (2006) has a ____ Chairperson and four ____ members.
n57dfcbbd28d.x: The NSC has a part-time Chairperson and four part-time members; the CEO of NITI Aayog is ex officio.

n4282d5d0075.s: The National Statistical Office (NSO), formed in 2019, functions under the:
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
n4282d5d0075.x: The NSO (CSO + NSSO, 2019) is under MoSPI and headed by the Chief Statistician of India.

nindian-economy-14-5.s: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is released by the NSO:
nindian-economy-14-5.x: The NSO releases the IIP monthly, covering mining, manufacturing and electricity.

n3cae3d35b9e.s: Among the NSO's national income estimates, which comes immediately after the Second Advance Estimate?
n3cae3d35b9e.x: The sequence is First Advance, Second Advance, Provisional, then First, Second and Third Revised Estimates.

nc8e22b32b11.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four institutional sectors in the 2022-23 national accounts series?
nc8e22b32b11.x: The four institutional sectors are government, public corporations, private corporations and households.

nbe6d74cde30.s:
Assertion (A): In 2014-15, the private corporate sector accounted for 35.9% of GVA.
Reason (R): The household sector's share of GVA was 45.5% in 2011-12 and 44.8% in 2014-15.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nbe6d74cde30.x: Both figures are correct, but the household share does not explain the private corporate share.

n276830f85a0.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: no dated items)
n276830f85a0.s: By 2017-18, agriculture's share in India's economy had declined to about:
n276830f85a0.x: Agriculture's share fell to about 17% by 2017-18; services now exceed 50%, followed by industry and agriculture.

nedc6635519c.s: India is projected to become the world's third-largest economy by:
nedc6635519c.x: India is projected to be third-largest by 2028 and upper-middle-income by 2030; the new-series downward revision pushes these further away.

nbe7905dccb6.s: In August 2025, S&P upgraded India's sovereign rating from BBB- to:
nbe7905dccb6.x: S&P upgraded India to BBB (affirmed BBB/A-2, stable), its first major upgrade in nearly two decades.

nfeefe91dfef.s: Which of the following does GDP NOT directly measure?
o: How income is distributed among people
The value of final goods and services produced
Output produced within the domestic territory
The level of economic activity in a period
nfeefe91dfef.x: GDP says nothing about distribution; dollar GDP rankings also move with exchange rates and base revisions.

n1577b9c0dca.s: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) was launched in:
n1577b9c0dca.x: The NIP was launched in December 2019; energy, roads, urban infrastructure and railways take the largest shares.

n7029de83ca5.s: Which of the following pairs (Census 2011 indicator – State) is INCORRECTLY matched?
n7029de83ca5.x: Arunachal Pradesh (17), not Goa, had the lowest population density; Goa was the most urbanised State.

n4c99efe7ec9.s:
Assertion (A): 1921-51 was a phase of steady population growth in India.
Reason (R): 1981-2011 was a phase of high but slowing population growth.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4c99efe7ec9.x: Both phases are correctly described (1901-21 stagnant, 1921-51 steady, 1951-81 rapid, 1981-2011 slowing), but a later phase cannot explain an earlier one.

n5a85a08eed1.shape: NOT (one-liner not honestly buildable: only one false fact)
n5a85a08eed1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the determinants of birth rate?
o: Female education influences the birth rate.
Higher child survival can affect fertility decisions.
Access to contraception has no relevance to the birth rate.
Urbanisation and the cost of raising children influence the birth rate.
n5a85a08eed1.x: Contraception access is relevant to fertility decisions and is a determinant of birth rate.

nffebd3efa3a.s: Which of the following would undermine India's demographic dividend?
nffebd3efa3a.x: Health, education, skills and jobs are needed to realise the dividend; reducing female labour-force participation would undermine it.

nindian-economy-71-17.s: In the demographic transition model, Stage II is marked by:
o: high birth rate and falling death rate
high birth rate and high death rate
falling birth rate and low death rate
low birth rate and low death rate
nindian-economy-71-17.x: Stage II has a high birth rate and falling death rate; Stage I high-high, Stage III falling-low, Stage IV low-low.

nindian-economy-71-9.s: In demographic analysis, the working-age population refers to persons aged:
nindian-economy-71-9.x: Working age is 15-64; young dependents are below 15 and old dependents 65 and above.

n091cfb75c98.s: Which stage of the demographic transition model produces a population explosion?
n091cfb75c98.x: Stage 2 combines a high birth rate with a falling death rate, producing a population explosion.

nee195706856.s: Which pair of States is in the ageing phase, with a falling working-age share?
nee195706856.x: Kerala and Tamil Nadu are ageing; Bihar and UP have a wide dividend window and Telangana and Uttarakhand a narrowing one.

n2ca6f35e2d5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the evolution of India's family planning programme?
o: The 42nd Amendment placed population control in the Concurrent List.
The first National Population Policy was announced in 1976.
The programme was renamed the Family Welfare Programme in 1977.
The target-free approach was introduced in 1986.
n2ca6f35e2d5.x: The target-free approach came in 1996, not 1986.

n6634f1fa5f3.s:
Assertion (A): India's family planning programme adopted a target-free approach in 1996.
Reason (R): The first National Population Policy was announced in 1976.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n6634f1fa5f3.x: Both dates are correct, but the 1976 policy does not explain the 1996 shift to a target-free approach.

n3291944d201.s: The long-term objective of the National Population Policy, 2000 was a stable population by:
n3291944d201.x: NPP 2000 aimed at stabilisation by 2045, with TFR 2.1 by 2010 as the medium-term goal.

n8787fa943cc.s: India's replacement-level TFR of 2.1, targeted by NPP 2000 for 2010, was actually reached around:
n8787fa943cc.x: TFR 2.1 was reached only around NFHS-5 (2019-21), not by 2010.

na085d3ecc0d.s: The National Policy on Older Persons, 1999 contains how many areas of intervention?
na085d3ecc0d.x: The policy, associated with the Ministry of Social Justice, has 14 areas of intervention including health care and nutrition.

n4a5f3b3cb35.s: Which of the following is associated with weak rural acceptance of family planning?
n4a5f3b3cb35.x: Son preference, children as old-age insurance, early marriage and low female literacy are all barriers.

nbcc23754e6a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about poverty measurement?
o: Absolute poverty can be measured against a fixed line such as the World Bank line.
Relative poverty is defined exclusively by a fixed calorie norm.
Relative poverty is widely used in developed economies.
A fixed calorie norm is associated with absolute poverty.
nbcc23754e6a.x: A fixed calorie norm belongs to absolute, not relative, poverty.

n278bc4761c6.s:
Assertion (A): The Squared Poverty Gap measures the severity of poverty.
Reason (R): It gives more weight to the poorest.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n278bc4761c6.x: By weighting the poorest more, the Squared Poverty Gap captures severity; HCR measures incidence and PGI depth.

n43542e433de.s:
Assertion (A): Governments may delay action on poverty committee reports.
Reason (R): Poverty lines are politically sensitive: a higher line raises fiscal costs and a lower line excludes the needy.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n43542e433de.x: The fiscal and exclusion effects make poverty lines politically sensitive, which is why action on reports may be delayed.

n74e8f7b0eb7.s: For urban areas, the Lakdawala methodology updated poverty lines using:
n74e8f7b0eb7.x: Lakdawala used CPI-AL for rural and CPI-IW for urban areas, with State-specific lines, and stopped scaling to National Accounts.

ndd789cd5376.s: The Dandekar-Rath study (1971) used a calorie norm of:
o: 2,100 kcal for both rural and urban
2,250 kcal for both rural and urban
ndd789cd5376.x: Dandekar-Rath used 2,250 kcal for both; 2,400/2,100 was Alagh and 2,155/2,090 Rangarajan.

nindian-economy-3-5.s: The Tendulkar Committee, set up in 2005, published its report in:
nindian-economy-3-5.x: The Tendulkar Committee (2005) reported in 2009; Dandekar-Rath was 1971 and Lakdawala 1989.

ndc76d24ec7e.s: Under the updated Rangarajan poverty line for 2022-23, the highest urban poverty ratio was in:
ndc76d24ec7e.x: Chhattisgarh had the highest urban (13.3%) and rural (25.1%) poverty ratios.

n9db6a7deb98.s: For 1993-94, the poverty ratio under the Tendulkar methodology was:

n905c019fb74.s: For 2011-12, the poverty ratio under the Rangarajan estimate was:

n2c32b1efc72.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about regional poverty differences in Andhra Pradesh?
o: A skill mismatch arises as the economy shifts towards technology.
Remoteness of tribal areas contributes to poverty.
Delta districts are poorer than Rayalaseema because of rain-fed agriculture.
Rayalaseema is the rain-fed and poorer region.
n2c32b1efc72.x: Rayalaseema is the rain-fed, poorer region; the irrigated delta districts are the least poor.

n55923bb1086.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Tendulkar method (2011-12), Chhattisgarh had the highest poverty ratio among the States.
Reason (R): Bihar had the largest number of poor persons in 2011-12.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n55923bb1086.x: Chhattisgarh had the highest ratio (39.93%), but Uttar Pradesh, not Bihar, had the largest number of poor.

n336baac87de.s: The Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana, a graduation-approach livelihood model, belongs to:
n336baac87de.x: Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana is Bihar's; Kerala has its poverty-eradication model and the Centre the Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana.

ncabf6cdee3d.s: Which of the following is NOT among the BIMARU and eastern belt States with concentrated poverty?
ncabf6cdee3d.x: The belt is Bihar, UP, MP, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Odisha and Chhattisgarh; Kerala is not in it.

n8877226cf58.s: Under the Tendulkar method (2011-12), Andhra Pradesh's total poverty ratio was:
n8877226cf58.x: AP's ratio was 9.20% (rural 10.96%, urban 5.81%) against India's 21.92%.

n5c5afeacdb0.s: Which of the following pairs (work – author) is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: The Price of Inequality – Joseph Stiglitz
Capital in the Twenty-First Century – Joseph Stiglitz
World Inequality Report – World Inequality Lab
n5c5afeacdb0.x: Capital in the Twenty-First Century is by Thomas Piketty, not Stiglitz.

n93f354ccafa.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Lorenz curve?
o: The X-axis shows the cumulative percentage of population, poorest first.
The Y-axis shows the cumulative percentage of income.
The Gini coefficient, not the curve, gives a single number for inequality.
The farther the curve bows from the 45-degree line, the lower the inequality.
n93f354ccafa.x: The 45-degree line is perfect equality, so bowing farther away means greater inequality.

ncf3159fde9b.s:
Assertion (A): The Laffer curve shows the relationship between tax rate and tax revenue.
Reason (R): The Phillips curve shows the relationship between inflation and unemployment.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncf3159fde9b.x: Both describe different curves correctly; one does not explain the other.

n1c00c823888.s: In India, consumption inequality is measured mainly using data from:
o: the All India Debt and Investment Survey
n1c00c823888.x: Consumption inequality rests on NSS/HCES; income inequality uses PLFS wages, tax data and WID; wealth uses AIDIS.

nf3de12d13c7.s: Wealth tax in India was abolished with effect from:
nf3de12d13c7.x: Wealth tax was abolished from 1 April 2016 for low yield and high compliance cost; estate duty went in 1985.

nindian-economy-36-2.s: 'The Economic History of India' was written by:
nindian-economy-36-2.x: R.C. Dutt wrote The Economic History of India; Smith, Ricardo and Stiglitz wrote the other listed works.

nf74cc4d675d.s: A Gini coefficient value of 0 indicates:
o: one person holds all the income
half the population holds all the income
nf74cc4d675d.x: The Gini runs from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (one person has everything).

nbdac4e89ff7.s: Which regions of Andhra Pradesh are identified as lagging in intra-State disparities?
nbdac4e89ff7.x: Rayalaseema and North Coastal districts lag; district MPI headcount ranges from 2.42% to 12.84%.

n78a2c0621d7.s: The Kuznets hypothesis describes the relationship between inequality and growth as:
n78a2c0621d7.x: Inequality first rises and then falls as the economy grows - an inverted U.

n40292cb6b80.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about voluntary and involuntary unemployment?
o: Voluntary unemployment means unwillingness to work at the prevailing wage.
Involuntary unemployment means being willing to work at the prevailing wage but finding no job.
The labour force counts only voluntary unemployment.
The labour force counts only involuntary unemployment.
n40292cb6b80.x: The labour force counts only involuntary, not voluntary, unemployment.

nd6a6ec2251c.shape: one-liner (match not buildable from given facts)
nd6a6ec2251c.s: India's basic unemployment problem is mainly:
nd6a6ec2251c.x: India's problem is structural, with seasonal, disguised and underemployment, unlike the demand-deficient unemployment Keynes stressed for developed economies.

n7aabdf9eec2.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: no dated items)
n7aabdf9eec2.s: According to Friedman and Phelps, the long-run Phillips curve is:
o: vertical at the natural rate of unemployment
n7aabdf9eec2.x: The short-run curve shows an inverse unemployment-inflation link, but in the long run it is vertical at the natural rate.

n7ac9539b596.s: Which of the following may still exist at full employment?
o: Involuntary unemployment of those willing at the prevailing wage
n7ac9539b596.x: Full employment means everyone willing at the prevailing wage finds work, but frictional and structural unemployment may persist.

n8adfb479d6c.s: Long-term unemployment arising from a mismatch between skills and available jobs is called:
n8adfb479d6c.x: Structural unemployment is a long-term skill-job mismatch; frictional unemployment is short-term job search.

na885104fdde.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the PLFS revamp from January 2025?
o: Monthly all-India CWS estimates began to be produced.
Quarterly estimates were extended to rural areas.
The sample was reduced to about one-half of its earlier size.
The annual report shifted to the calendar year.
na885104fdde.x: The sample was raised, not reduced, to about 2,72,304 households.

nc412b5f0d0b.s:
Assertion (A): Unemployment rates under CWS are higher than under UPSS.
Reason (R): The short 7-day CWS reference period captures seasonal unemployment.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc412b5f0d0b.x: Because the 7-day reference period picks up seasonal unemployment, CWS rates exceed UPSS rates.

n66e5c27facd.s: PLFS 2022-23 put graduate unemployment at about:
n66e5c27facd.x: PLFS 2022-23 gave 3.2% overall unemployment and 13% for graduates.

n43ce891203c.s: Critics argue that the CWS measure of unemployment may mask:
n43ce891203c.x: CWS is criticised for masking underemployment and missing circular migration.

n8376a12bbeb.s: Under PLFS 2023-24 (usual status), Andhra Pradesh's unemployment rate was:
n8376a12bbeb.x: AP's rate was 4.1% against India's 3.2%; AP's rural rate (3.4%) was below its urban rate (5.9%).

nindian-economy-48-2-5.x: WPR is employed over total population; LFPR is labour force over working-age population.

n67acd5786c8.s: The Unemployment Rate (UR) is unemployed persons as a percentage of the:
n67acd5786c8.x: UR uses the labour force as base; the proportion unemployed (PU) uses the population.

neaff3eed6f1.s: CMIE unemployment data differ from PLFS data in being:
o: annual, with the same methodology as PLFS
monthly, but with a methodology identical to PLFS
based on the PLFS methodology with a smaller sample
monthly, with a larger sample and a different methodology
neaff3eed6f1.x: CMIE data are monthly with a larger sample and a different methodology, which makes their estimates diverge.

n62dd52670d8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the employment problem of India's post-1991 growth?
o: Employment growth did not keep pace with labour-force growth.
Employment generation was sufficiently concentrated in labour-intensive manufacturing.
Unemployment increasingly appeared in the unorganised sector.
Growth was not sufficiently concentrated in labour-intensive manufacturing.
n62dd52670d8.x: Growth was not sufficiently concentrated in labour-intensive manufacturing.

n78c1e54093e.s:
Assertion (A): A near-zero employment elasticity is a sign of jobless growth.
Reason (R): The term 'jobless growth' was coined by Arthur Lewis in the 1950s.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n78c1e54093e.x: Near-zero elasticity means output grows with little job growth, but the term was coined by Nick Perna in the early 1990s.

n4f734913978.s: Against Andhra Pradesh's all-age female LFPR of 35.8%, the all-India figure is:
n4f734913978.x: India's all-age female LFPR is 31.7%, lower than AP's 35.8%.

n3cf12b051b4.s: Which of the following is correct about the measurement of gig workers in India?
o: PLFS records gig workers as a separate category.
All gig workers are registered on e-Shram.
PLFS does not yet capture gig workers as a distinct category.
n3cf12b051b4.x: PLFS does not yet identify gig workers separately, and most remain outside e-Shram registration.

n375a878aa39.s:
Assertion (A): The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 lets States pause works for up to 60 days during sowing and harvest seasons.
Reason (R): The Act reduced the administrative cost ceiling to 6%.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n375a878aa39.x: The 60-day seasonal pause is correct, but the ceiling was 6% under MGNREGA and is raised to 9% under VB-G RAM G.

n24d8b0dbd55.s: MGNREGA covers rural households whose adult members volunteer for:
n24d8b0dbd55.x: MGNREGA targets rural households volunteering for unskilled manual work, not urban skilled workers.

nfcccb833a61.s: DDU-GKY, which provides placement-linked skilling to rural poor youth, has its roots in the special projects of:
nfcccb833a61.x: DDU-GKY (2014, Ministry of Rural Development) grew out of the special projects of SGSY, not PMEGP.

n981748f792f.s: MGNREGA wages must be paid within how many days of the work done?
n981748f792f.x: Wages are due within 15 days, delay attracts compensation, and payment is by DBT to Aadhaar-linked accounts.

n8423c6f59a0.s: Which 1985 Supreme Court case linked livelihood with Article 21?
n8423c6f59a0.x: Olga Tellis (1985) linked livelihood with Article 21; MGNREGA is described as the only law built on the right to work.

nc27a05fafe7.s: Which of the following is a self-employment programme?
nc27a05fafe7.x: IRDP (like NRLM) is a self-employment programme; NREP and MGNREGS are wage-employment programmes.

nfbd36bb6c63.s: The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is implemented by the:
nfbd36bb6c63.x: PMEGP is administered by the Ministry of MSME and implemented by the KVIC.

nindian-society-1-52.s:
Assertion (A): MGNREGA, 2005 was India's first rights-based welfare legislation.
Reason (R): The IRDP pilot began in 1976.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nindian-society-1-52.x: Both are true, but the 1976 IRDP pilot does not explain MGNREGA's rights-based character.

n93ab7ca53ee.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: too few dated items)
n93ab7ca53ee.s: Indira Kranthi Patham (2004-05) in Andhra Pradesh was formed by merging Velugu with:
n93ab7ca53ee.x: IKP came later by merging Velugu (2000, World Bank-aided) and DWCRA; it was not Velugu's earlier name.

n06dc6431991.s: Which SHG-based programme of 2001 aims at the integrated empowerment of women?
n06dc6431991.x: Swayamsiddha (2001) is SHG-based; Rashtriya Mahila Kosh (1993) gives micro-credit and STEP gives skills and employment.

nb5d389d75e8.s: Which State's SERP/Velugu model became a template for NRLM?
nb5d389d75e8.x: AP's SERP/Velugu model became NRLM's template, and AP leads in SHG-bank linkage.

n3c9b317a372.s: The South Asia Poverty Alleviation Programme (SAPAP) in Andhra Pradesh, begun in 1995, was supported by:
n3c9b317a372.x: SAPAP was UNDP-supported in Mahabubnagar, Kurnool and Anantapur; the World Bank aided Velugu (2000).

n843668d65d4.s: IRDP was implemented in all blocks from:
n843668d65d4.x: IRDP, combining subsidy with bank credit to lift rural families above the poverty line, covered all blocks from 2 October 1980.

nfd34d912b9e.s: Pavala Vaddi, an interest subsidy for SHGs in Andhra Pradesh, was introduced in:
nfd34d912b9e.x: Pavala Vaddi came in 2004; Vaddi Leni Runalu rewards prompt (not delayed) repayment.

n094b3782abe.s: Under DAY-NRLM, up to what share of SHG members may be slightly above the poverty line?
n094b3782abe.x: Only up to 30% may be slightly above the poverty line; beneficiaries are identified by PIP and vetted by the Gram Sabha.

n8cbfa57a509.s: Unnati is a SERP programme in Andhra Pradesh for:
n8cbfa57a509.x: Unnati targets the poorest SC/ST SHG households; Stree Nidhi gives credit to SHG members in rural and urban areas.

n8f3651c71cb.s: The general Centre-State funding ratio under DAY-NRLM is:
n8f3651c71cb.x: The general ratio is 60:40; 90:10 applies to the North-Eastern States including Sikkim, and UTs get 100%.

nindian-economy-34-5.s: The Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (1989) was formed by merging NREP with:
nindian-economy-34-5.x: NREP (rural employment) and RLEGP (rural landless employment) were merged into JRY in 1989.

nindian-society-1-54.s: India's first National Nutrition Policy was formulated in:
nindian-society-1-54.x: The Nutrition Policy came in 1993; the first Health Policy in 1983 and the Population Policy in 1976.

n606019c61d9.s: Under DAY-NRLM, the tier above the Village Organisation is the:
n606019c61d9.x: DAY-NRLM's three tiers are SHG, Village Organisation and Cluster-Level Federation.

n59861b3fa02.s:
Assertion (A): The Health Insurance Scheme for weavers covers a family of four: self, spouse and two children.
Reason (R): A prescribed age cap is an eligibility criterion under the scheme.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n59861b3fa02.x: The family-of-four cover is correct, but there is no age cap; eligibility needs at least 50% income from handloom work.

n240d4acc33b.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: no dated items)
n240d4acc33b.s: The National Social Assistance Programme fulfils the directive contained in Article ____ of the Constitution.
n240d4acc33b.x: NSAP, a Centrally Sponsored Core of Core scheme for BPL households, fulfils Article 41.

n49424d7499a.s: In Phase II of PMJDY (2015-2018), unorganised-sector pensions were provided under:
n49424d7499a.x: Phase II added overdraft, a Credit Guarantee Fund for overdraft defaults and Swavalamban pensions.

n1c247cdfe12.s: The Unified Pension Scheme assures a pension of what share of average basic pay of the last 12 months for 25 years of service?
n1c247cdfe12.x: UPS assures 50% of average basic pay of the last 12 months; unlike NPS it is Government-backed.

n180282b5852.s: PM Kisan Maan-dhan provides small and marginal farmers a monthly pension at age 60 of:
n180282b5852.x: PM-KMY gives ₹3,000 a month at 60; ₹1,000-5,000 is the APY range.

n7604a7e39be.s: Which of the following is a recognised challenge of Aadhaar-enabled service delivery?
o: Exclusion due to biometric authentication failure
Easier authentication for those with worn fingerprints
n7604a7e39be.x: Biometric failure can exclude the elderly and labourers with worn fingerprints, and centralised data raises privacy concerns.

nd303e6307d3.s: In the 2017 Puttaswamy judgement, privacy was held to be a fundamental right under Article 21 by a Bench of:
nd303e6307d3.x: A nine-judge Bench decided in 2017; a five-judge Bench upheld Aadhaar for welfare in 2018.

n9ffed27f0c7.s: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides cover for:
n9ffed27f0c7.x: PMSBY covers accidental death and disability; death from any cause is covered by PMJJBY.

n93a1260eaa7.s: The overdraft facility under PMJDY has been raised to:
n93a1260eaa7.x: Overdraft rose from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000, and RuPay accident cover from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh.

n73dbdb41cb0.s: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan covers unorganised workers aged 18-40 with monthly income up to:
n73dbdb41cb0.x: The income limit is ₹15,000; persons covered under NPS, ESIC or EPFO are excluded.

nfe756d0d119.s: The four labour codes together replaced how many labour laws?
nfe756d0d119.x: The four codes replaced 29 laws; the 2008 Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act is subsumed in the Code on Social Security, 2020.

n301a4f66632.s: The DBT pilot launched on 1 January 2013 covered:
n301a4f66632.x: The pilot covered 7 schemes in 20 districts; DBT was scaled up in 2015 using JAM.

n38315d75e30.s: The Food Corporation of India was created under the:
n38315d75e30.x: The Food Corporations Act, 1964 created FCI; the Essential Commodities Act regulates essential goods.

n23b05df32a9.s: Under the NFSA, the District Grievance Redressal Officer is provided under Section:
n23b05df32a9.x: Section 15 provides the DGRO; State Food Commissions monitor implementation and hear appeals.

n6a0da54e743.s: India's strategic foodgrain reserve is about how much above operational stocks?
n6a0da54e743.x: The strategic reserve is 5 million tonnes above operational stocks.

n64ad1c6911d.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh PDS, an Antyodaya Anna Yojana household receives free rice of:
n64ad1c6911d.x: AAY households get 35 kg per card; Priority Households get 5 kg per unit.

n3d131198470.s: Under the NFSA, which body is provided in each State, though an existing commission may be designated for it?
n3d131198470.x: Each State has a State Food Commission, and an existing body may be designated to avoid new costs.

nc741b0991a5.s: The National Food Security Act commenced in:
nc741b0991a5.x: NFSA commenced in July 2013; 'NFSA 2014' is a known distractor.

n5bada225ceb.s: The Targeted Public Distribution System was introduced in:
n5bada225ceb.x: TPDS came in June 1997, after RPDS (June 1992) and before NFSA (2013).

n6efff29aa84.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about population norms for habitations under PMGSY?
o: Hill States, North-East, deserts and Schedule V areas: 250 or more
n6efff29aa84.x: In LWE-affected blocks the norm is 100+, not 250+.

nindian-economy-3-6.s:
Assertion (A): The Employment Guarantee Scheme first started in Maharashtra in 1972.
Reason (R): Antyodaya first started in Rajasthan in 1977-78.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nindian-economy-3-6.x: Both are true, but a later Rajasthan programme cannot explain Maharashtra's 1972 scheme.

n97236fd0f47.s: Under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0, Union Territories without legislature receive:
n97236fd0f47.x: UTs without legislature get 100% Union funding; Himalayan/NE States and UTs with legislature 90:10; other States 50:50.

ncd480fa12bc.s: Andhra Pradesh's Jal Jeevan Mission coverage in March 2024 was reported at:
ncd480fa12bc.x: AP's 73% was below the national 82%; its JJM 2.0 target is safe water to every household by 2028.

n949b5ed52b8.s: The Union Cabinet extended the Jal Jeevan Mission, originally due in 2024, up to:
n949b5ed52b8.x: JJM was extended to December 2028, with JJM 2.0 shifting focus to service delivery.

n25f3f45bafa.s: The Drought-Prone Area Programme (DPAP) was launched in:
n25f3f45bafa.x: DPAP dates to 1973-74; the Desert Development Programme (1977-78) covers both hot and cold deserts.

nindian-economy-3-8.s: 'Garibi Hatao' was first introduced in which Five Year Plan?
nindian-economy-3-8.x: Garibi Hatao entered planning with the Fifth Plan.

nf9946d3149e.s: Critical Gap Funding under the Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission is up to what share of project cost?
nf9946d3149e.x: The mission relies mainly on convergence of schemes, with Critical Gap Funding up to 30% of project cost.

n83fa8718170.s: In rural development, NRLM primarily promotes:
n83fa8718170.x: NRLM promotes SHG-based self-employment, while MGNREGA provides up to 100 days of wage employment.

ne18e66c3967.s: JJM 2.0 shifts the emphasis from infrastructure creation to:
o: service delivery, including operation and maintenance
ne18e66c3967.x: JJM 2.0 focuses on service delivery, including sustainable operation and maintenance.
